ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The following figure is an isoline distribution map of land production potential (g/m²·year) in Shanxi Province based on a certain factor. Read the figure and answer: <image1> What is the value of land production potential at place M in the figure?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is an isoline distribution of land production potential within the outline of Shanxi Province; the isolines are labeled with values such as 700, 750, 800, 850, 900, and 950; these values generally increase gradually from north to south. Point M is located at the southern end of the figure, on the high-value side south of the 950 isoline. Then reason: The difference between adjacent isoline values is 50, indicating that the contour interval is 50. Estimating in the direction roughly perpendicular to the isolines near M, point M is about 1.3 contour intervals farther in the high-value direction than the 950 isoline; therefore the value at place M is about 950+1.3×50=1015.
